description: Checks of the suite itself: things that must fail loudly (silent no-ops, a camera target that does not exist, an 'on' scenario whose host never built) and a person's edge case that must work (the bucket clicked again after Clear).

scenarios.note: Bucket, Clear, bucket on the same spot: a person's mouse comes back from the panel, so the second click picks the block again. Expected PASS.
Expected FAIL with a reason for each: unknown preset, unknown option, anarchy without the Anarchy mod.
A strip mall places no entrance markers: entrance 3 does not exist. Expected FAIL (camera error) and no picture.
A one-line scenario of a type that does not exist: it never builds.
Expected refused: its host never built.
